about.title:
Curious by nature.
An engineer in the making.
paragraphs: I’m Safrin, a final-year AI & ML engineering student who loves understanding how things work — and making them work better.

My journey started with AI automation, prompt engineering, and evaluating LLM outputs. Today, I’m connecting that experience to cloud infrastructure, DevOps, and RAG-based systems. I’m interested in the whole picture: not just building something intelligent, but making it reliable, useful, and ready for the real world.

projects.name: NURA
projects.tagline: Technology that looks out for you.
projects.description: A women’s safety platform that brings SOS alerts, safe-route recommendations, and a smart SOS locket together in one connected experience.
projects.imageAlt: Concept visualization of a silver SOS safety pendant and a companion smartphone
projects.imageCaption: Product concept visualization · Not a photograph of the prototype
projects.details: NURA explores how intelligent software and a physical safety device can work together. The React and TypeScript front end brings emergency alerts and safe-route recommendations into a single interface, with cloud integration connecting the experience. A smart SOS locket prototype extends the concept beyond the phone.
features: React / TypeScript front end with cloud integration

experience.description: Turning ideas into execution. Managed cross-functional projects, built AI-assisted workflows, and maintained quality standards using ChatGPT, Gemini, RunwayML, and Google Veo.
Creating space for people to learn and build. Organized technical events and workshops, coordinated teams, and secured sponsorships to bring initiatives to life.
